text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Clear, descriptive tool menu makes it easy to pick the right tool for tasks or documents.",
    "Simple To-do management allows inline addition and easy completion tracking.",
    "Calendar tool effectively manages events, milestones, and deadlines.",
    "Card Table offers a visual way to track work with cards and columns.",
    "Empty project prompts guide new users on how to get started.",
    "Onboarding tour is skippable for experienced users."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Tools must be added manually to each project, requiring extra setup steps.",
    "Free plan is limited to a single project, restricting separate workstreams.",
    "Default event times in the calendar often require manual adjustment to all-day.",
    "Adding the To-dos tool requires an extra title-rename step before use.",
    "Page layout shifts after adding tools, causing minor UI disruption.",
    "Projects start completely empty without any pre-configured tasks or status templates."
  ],
  "overall_rating": "3.5"
}

pros: Clear, descriptive tool menu makes it easy to pick the right tool for tasks or documents.
Simple To-do management allows inline addition and easy completion tracking.
Calendar tool effectively manages events, milestones, and deadlines.
Card Table offers a visual way to track work with cards and columns.
Empty project prompts guide new users on how to get started.
Onboarding tour is skippable for experienced users.
cons: Tools must be added manually to each project, requiring extra setup steps.
Free plan is limited to a single project, restricting separate workstreams.
Default event times in the calendar often require manual adjustment to all-day.
Adding the To-dos tool requires an extra title-rename step before use.
Page layout shifts after adding tools, causing minor UI disruption.
Projects start completely empty without any pre-configured tasks or status templates.
